title: 1 YEAR RUSH Begins
description: The preparation year begins. A personal commitment to push beyond my comfort zone, strengthen my cybersecurity knowledge, gain practical experience and pursue professional certifications before internship.

title: Perwira Cyber Industrial Training
description: Selected to participate in the Perwira Cyber Industrial Training, a fully funded training programme for selected participants, conducted in collaboration with NADI Cybersecurity and BlackBerry Cybersecurity Center of Excellence.

title: Mini Cyber Awareness Programme
description: Conducting a physical mini cyber awareness programme at NADI Semenyih, organised by NADI × Cybersecurity. The initiative aims to educate students about cyber threats and scams, including how to identify suspicious activities, respond to potential threats and protect themselves from scams.

title: Internship Preparation Goal
description: Targeting my internship period. The objective is to enter the industry with stronger technical skills, practical experience, professional certifications and a portfolio of meaningful work.
